KP 1. Differentiating an Inverse Sine Function
1.?

Find f′(x) for f(x)=arcsin3⁡(2x).

H
Sun, Sep 13th @ 4:35 PM|Elapsed: 6:29Correct

The formula for the derivative of arcsine is ddx(arcsin⁡x)=11−x2.

Using the chain rule and the formula above, we get

f′(x)=ddx[arcsin3⁡(2x)]=3arcsin2⁡(2x)⋅ddx[arcsin⁡(2x)]=3arcsin2⁡(2x)⋅[11−(2x)2⋅ddx(2x)]=3arcsin2⁡(2x)⋅[11−(2x)2⋅2]=3arcsin2⁡(2x)⋅21−4x2=6arcsin2⁡(2x)1−4x2.

2.?

Find f′(x) for f(x)=arcsin⁡2x9.

M
Sun, Sep 13th @ 4:37 PM|Elapsed: 1:41Correct

The formula for the derivative of arcsine is ddx(arcsin⁡x)=11−x2.

Using the chain rule and the formula above, we get

f′(x)=ddx(arcsin⁡2x9)=19⋅ddx(arcsin⁡2x)=19⋅11−(2x)2⋅ddx(2x)=19⋅11−4x2⋅2=291−4x2.

KP 2. Differentiating an Inverse Cosine Function
3.?

Calculate f′(x) for f(x)=5arccos⁡(ex).

H
Sun, Sep 13th @ 4:39 PM|Elapsed: 2:23Correct

The formula for the derivative of arccosine is ddx(arccos⁡x)=−11−x2.

Using the chain rule and the formula above, we get

f′(x)=ddx[5arccos⁡(ex)]=5⋅(−11−(ex)2)⋅ddx(ex)=5⋅(−11−(ex)2)⋅ex=−5ex1−e2x.

4.?

Calculate f′(x) for f(x)=arccos⁡(5+3x2).

H
Sun, Sep 13th @ 4:43 PM|Elapsed: 3:09Correct

The formula for the derivative of arccosine is ddx(arccos⁡x)=−11−x2.

Using the chain rule and the formula above, we get

f′(x)=ddxarccos⁡(5+3x2)=−11−(5+3x2)2⋅ddx(5+3x2)=−11−(5+3x2)2⋅(6x)=−6x1−(5+3x2)2.

KP 3. Differentiating an Inverse Tangent Function
5.?

Calculate dydx for y=3−6arctan⁡(2x−1).

M
Sun, Sep 13th @ 4:47 PM|Elapsed: 4:04Correct

The formula for the derivative of arctangent is ddx(arctan⁡x)=11+x2.

Using the chain rule and the formula above, we get

dydx=ddx(3−6arctan⁡(2x−1))=0−6⋅ddx(arctan⁡(2x−1))=0−6⋅11+(2x−1)2⋅ddx(2x−1)=0−6⋅11+(2x−1)2⋅2=0−6⋅21+(2x−1)2=−122+4x2−4x=6−1+2x−2x2.

6.?

Find f′(x) for f(x)=2−3arctan⁡x8.

E
Sun, Sep 13th @ 4:48 PM|Elapsed: 1:11Correct

The formula for the derivative of arctangent is ddx(arctan⁡x)=11+x2.

Using the formula above, we get f′(x)=ddx(2−3arctan⁡x8)=0−38⋅ddx(arctan⁡x)=−38⋅11+x2=−38(1+x2).

Applying the quotient rule, using the formula for the derivative of arctan⁡x, and applying the chain rule, we get dydx=ddx(arctan⁡(3x2)x2+1)=((x2+1)⋅ddx(arctan⁡(3x2))−arctan⁡(3x2)⋅ddx(x2+1))(x2+1)2=((x2+1)⋅11+(3x2)2⋅ddx(3x2)−arctan⁡(3x2)⋅2x)(x2+1)2=((x2+1)(6x)1+9x4−2xarctan⁡(3x2))(x2+1)2=6x(x2+1)(1+9x4)−2x(x2+1)2arctan⁡(3x2).

8.?

Calculate dydx for y=exarcsin⁡x.

E
Sun, Sep 13th @ 4:55 PM|Elapsed: 1:33Correct

Applying the product rule and using the formula for the derivative of arcsin⁡x, we get

ddx(exarcsin⁡x)=arcsin⁡x⋅ddx(ex)+ex⋅ddx(arcsin⁡x)=arcsin⁡x⋅ex+ex⋅11−x2=ex(arcsin⁡x+11−x2).
